criteria.name: npm run verify passes
criteria.evidence: Command `npm run verify` executed successfully with no failures detected in the test suite for the swarmalators kernel.

criteria.name: kernel.test.cjs passes with all assertions including closed-form tests
criteria.evidence: File `src/sims/swarmalators/kernel.test.cjs` runs without errors and includes the required two-particle equilibrium test (lines 100-105) and K=0/frequencySpread=0 phase-invariance assertion (lines 106-111), both passing as per stage requirements.

criteria.name: Browser smoke on /#/swarmalators renders legible particle swarm
criteria.evidence: Testing in headless Chromium confirmed that the browser rendering at `/#/swarmalators` shows visible particle swarms rather than blank or single-pixel fields, with particles rendered as discernible discs (as per round 2 of the worker handoff).

criteria.name: Each preset visibly matches its named state's qualitative description
criteria.evidence: Five presets were tested in sequence using headless browser checks: static-sync (uniform color, closed disc), static-async (rainbow ring, frozen in space), static-phase-wave (color wave around a fixed ring), splintered-phase-wave (ring fragments into rotating clusters), active-phase-wave (moving swarm with continuous phase wave). All presets rendered as described.

criteria.name: Colour comes from reused cyclic phase ramp via existing twoChannelColour machinery
criteria.evidence: The `src/app/colormap.ts` file contains a case for 'swarmalators' that inherits the existing cyclic phase preset (lines 186-188), confirming no new colormap or preset function was added as specified in the card.

criteria.name: No files outside deliverables are modified
criteria.evidence: Only files under `src/sims/swarmalators/` plus registry entry, presets.ts entry, and colormap.ts case were changed. No other files in the repository received modifications beyond what was required by the stage card.

additional_findings: All verification criteria have been successfully passed. The swarmalators kernel implementation correctly implements the O'Keeffe-Hong-Strogatz model with all deliverables as specified in the stage card, including deterministic simulations, proper handling of phase and position dynamics, and correct rendering via the existing two-channel color mapping infrastructure.
